C-MACRO:Unknown/replaced expander or effects outside controlled trace; an include-only trace cannot certify it
C-EVAL:Unmanaged evaluator replacement, namespace state or native capability; symbol allowlist alone is insufficient
C-REQUIRE:Unregistered module resolution, initialization, dynamic library closure or unknown load outcome
C-LOAD:Unknown native object, constructor/initialization effects, unresolved dependent library or callback ownership
C-CHAR:Unknown handler or mutable state not included in producer context; missing callback trace
C-SHARP:Unknown sharp procedure or effect bypass, even if source file bytes match
C-COMMENT:Dropping comments as semantically irrelevant while comment callback effects are untracked
C-SHARP-DOT:Enabled read-time eval with unmanaged effects; do not assume selected profile enables the branch
C-BUFFER:Live/inherited mutable device, shared offset race, untracked wait callback or unsettled buffered output
C-FFI:Unknown native symbol/provider or transitive syscall, inherited capability or unsupervised callback
C-C-READ:Unbound backend/foreign device or active unqualified read pump, live fd reuse/alias, missing source/image lifetime or unknown result
C-C-OPEN:Live namespace bypass, native pointer escape, failed wrapper ownership not settled
C-NATIVE-TEXT:Do not reject just for C text; reject reusable execution only when an actual unmanaged build-time effect occurs
C-EMIT:Partial/truncated output, unknown write/close result or publication without success/group custody
O-C-BYTES:Prove byte encoding equality and complete consumer context; c-declare/c-initialize are included as bytes
O-LINK-DATUM:Prove parser/serializer acceptance and all consumed fields/order; no JSON normalization or symbol/string conflation
O-ROLE-GROUP:Prove role-specific group completeness and currentness; native module/descriptor/executable products cannot be interchanged
O-INTEGER-SCENARIO:Construct a commuting producer relation if transferring that scenario; otherwise use structured observation protocol and an independent oracle
O-REFLECTION:Prove actual clean origin, output fidelity, error/epoch/group reflection, full-budget and capability mapping
